questions.q: 9. The least multiple of 23 when divided by 18, 21 and 24 leaves the remainder 7, 10 and 13 respectively. The number is;
questions.s:
9.(b) Here (18 - 7) = (21 - 10) = (24 - 13) = 11,
LCM of 18, 21, 24 = 504,
So, the least multiple of 23 when divided by 18, 21 and 24 leave the remainder 7, 10 and 13 respectively is=504k-11 [where k = 1,2,3,....]
Now we can write,
504k-11 = 483k+21k-11[here 483 is divisible by 23, so we have to find for which value of k, (21k-11) will be divisible by 23]
If we put k = 6,
21k-11 = 126-11 =115 [115 is divisible by 23]
So, the least multiple of 23 when divided by 18, 21 and 24 leave the remainder 7, 10 and 13 respectively is
504k-11 = 504×6-11 = 3024-11 = 3013

questions.q:
If 27662AB is divisible by 80. Then find the value of (A + B) such that B<A<5.

यदि 27662AB, 80 से विभाज्य है। तो (A + B) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए ताकि B<A<5 हो।
questions.s:
We know that 80 = 8 x 10 and if a number is divisible by 80, then it must be divisible by 10 and 8.

For divisible by 10, the last digit of the number should be 0. So, B = 0.

And for divisible by 8, the last three digits should be divisible by 8.

The last three digits = 2A0

To be divisible by 8, the only possible value of A is 4.

Therefore, (A + B) = 4 + 0 = 4.

questions_hin.q_hi:
Find the smallest number which when increased by 15 is completely divisible by 11, 8, 12, 15 and 25.

वह सबसे छोटी संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए जो 15 से बढ़ाने पर 11, 8, 12, 15 और 25 से पूर्णतः विभाज्य हो।
questions_hin.s_hi:
Required number = (LCM of 11, 8, 12, 15, and 25) - 15

Factor of 11 = 11

Factor of 8 = 23

Factor of 12 = 22 * 3

Factor of 15 = 3 * 5

Factor of 25 = 52

LCM = 11 * 23 * 3 * 52 = 6600

Required number = 6600 - 15 = 6585

questions_hin.q_hi:
If 27662AB is divisible by 80. Then find the value of (A + B) such that B<A<5.

यदि 27662AB, 80 से विभाज्य है। तो (A + B) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए ताकि B<A<5 हो।
questions_hin.s_hi:
We know that 80 = 8 x 10 and if a number is divisible by 80, then it must be divisible by 10 and 8.

For divisible by 10, the last digit of the number should be 0. So, B = 0.

And for divisible by 8, the last three digits should be divisible by 8.

The last three digits = 2A0

To be divisible by 8, the only possible value of A is 4.

Therefore, (A + B) = 4 + 0 = 4.
